title: Actuators pulled out of portals

tellings.quote: that and actuators with this John Silison guy that there's these actuators that they pull out of the portals

plain: There are said to be actuators, the parts that make a machine move, that "they pull out of the portals." The researcher Grant Cameron mentions this only in passing on Michels's show, as something he heard from a man named John Sillison, and he names Ron Pandolfi and Dan Smith in the same conversation. If true, it would mean someone is recovering working hardware from something called portals, though Cameron does not say what the portals are or who does the pulling.
